commands: rm -rf build src/target && mkdir -p build/msgs build/classes
cd src && JAVA_HOME="$JDK8" PATH="$JDK8/bin:$PATH" mvn -B -q -Denforcer.skip=true generate-sources dependency:copy-dependencies -DincludeScope=compile -DoutputDirectory=../build/deps
(cd src/src/main/resources && find org/jenkinsci/plugins/tokenmacro \( -name '*.properties' -o -name '*.jelly' \) | sort | tar -cf - -T -) | tar -xf - -C build/classes
tools: git, Maven 3.9 run on JDK 8 (--jdk8; the project's pom, its parent org.jenkins-ci.plugins:plugin:3.2 and jenkins-core 1.642.3 come from https://repo.jenkins-ci.org/public/, declared in the pom), JDK 8 javac, JDK 17 (javac, jar), tar
notes: As the evaluation's jar was made: javac --release 8 -proc:none (JDK 17) of every .java file under src/main/java, then Messages.properties and the *.jelly files under org/jenkinsci/plugins/tokenmacro from src/main/resources. The localizer-generated Messages class (the tree has only Messages.properties) is made by the project's own Maven build (generate-sources, localizer 1.24, enforcer skipped) and compiled with JDK 8 javac -g -source 1.7 -target 1.7 (the pom's java.level 7); this gives the same bytes as the Messages.class of the released token-macro-2.5.jar, which is what the evaluation's jar contains (the commit is the one right after the 2.5 release; its sources equal 2.5's). The compile class path is the pom's compile and provided dependencies (Maven dependency:copy-dependencies -DincludeScope=compile; jenkins-core 1.642.3 and its tree). Fixed version: token-macro 2.6 (first patched release, published only on repo.jenkins-ci.org, not on Maven Central) with parboiled-java/parboiled-core 1.1.8, which 2.6 needs (it does not work with the 1.1.7 the vulnerable side uses).
